caseNameFull: Poythress, Secretary of State of Georgia v. Duncan

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. [Cer-tiorari granted, 455 U. S. 937.] Oral argument in this case, presently scheduled for November 1, 1982, is hereby postponed and the case of Federal Election Commission et al. v. National Right to Work Committee et al., No. 81-1506 [cer-tiorari granted, 456 U. S. 914], is set for oral argument in its stead.
